institutionOverview.name: Institution Name
institutionOverview.scope: Institution totals include all Bureaus in your permitted region. Case records, charts, deadlines and actions follow your separate case permissions.

intake.title: Case Intake
intake.description: Prepare a source record, resolve its institution, and submit it to an authorized supervisor.
intake.sourceNotice: Email, letter, CPGRAMS, CSS and custom channels record manually entered source metadata only. No external system is connected.
intake.queueScope: Officers see their own drafts. Supervisors see drafts within their current Bureau and region permissions.
intake.noDrafts: No intake records in your scope.
intake.saved: Intake saved without attaching an institution.
intake.failed: Intake could not be completed. Check your fields, access and current record version, then retry.
intake.ambiguous: Several institutions match. Check the location and identifiers, then select one explicitly.
intake.humanSelection: Review the ranked results and confirm an institution explicitly.
intake.remainUnresolved: The intake remains unresolved. Verify the source identifier or ask a supervisor to update the institution master data.
intake.rankingNotice: Rankings use lexical names, aliases, location hints and exact identifiers. They are not probability estimates. An explicit identifier never falls back to a different name match.
intake.resolutionReason: Reason for institution selection / master-data change
intake.matchingNotice: Supervisor action. Enter one alias per line, and one NAMESPACE:VALUE identifier per line. The canonical AICTE identifier remains unchanged.
intake.lifecycleReviewNotice: This case type has no approved operational lifecycle configured. Keep it in intake review; no complaint deadline has been started.
intake.supervisorRegistration: An authorized Bureau Head or Competent Authority must register this draft.
intake.registrationNotice: Confirm the classification, source metadata and selected institution. Registration uses the configured operational complaint lifecycle and existing overlap review. The default deadline is an operational target, not a verified statutory deadline.
intake.configurationNotice: Versioned administrative metadata configuration. Existing records, IDs, source references and case data are preserved.
intake.lifecycleConfigurationNotice: Only enable the default complaint workflow when it is appropriate for the case type. Other case types remain in lifecycle review; this setting does not establish a statutory policy.
intake.legacyMetadataNotice: Classification and source provenance were not recorded for this historical case. No source or case type has been inferred.

errors.INTAKE_CONFLICT: This intake changed. Refresh and review the current record before retrying.
errors.CONFIGURATION_CONFLICT: The configuration changed. Reload before saving a new version.
errors.SOURCE_REFERENCE_UNAVAILABLE: This source reference cannot be registered. Ask an authorized supervisor to review the intake.
errors.INTAKE_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Resolve the institution and lifecycle review before registration.
errors.INVALID_SOURCE_DATE: Enter a valid source received date.
errors.INVALID_CLASSIFICATION: Choose an enabled case type, source, category and priority.
errors.IDENTIFIER_UNAVAILABLE: This identifier cannot be added. Review the master-data identifiers.
errors.EXTERNAL_CONNECTOR_UNAVAILABLE: External connectors cannot be enabled through source metadata configuration.

security.title: Confidentiality and identity protection
security.matrixNotice: Internal records follow existing role, Bureau, region and assignment permissions. Restricted and sealed records also require explicit case-read grants. For restricted and sealed records, evidence also requires its own grant. Identity always requires an explicit grant. Grants never replace existing role or jurisdiction checks.
security.signalsNotice: Ragging, POSH, SC/ST-related and other configured signals request an appropriate human review. Signals do not establish a legal classification, verified finding or universal handling rule.
security.grantNotice: Only authorized Competent Authorities manage case security. Current role, region, assignment and coordination membership still apply. The reviewing authority retains an explicit management grant for restricted/sealed records.
security.reason: Official reason (do not enter identity details)
security.failed: The security action could not be completed. Check your permissions, current record version and encryption configuration.
security.identityNotice: Identity is encrypted separately. Every reveal requires a reason and is audited. Revealed values clear from this panel after one minute or when the panel closes. Do not place identities in ordinary case narratives.
security.keyUnavailable: Identity protection is unavailable until an operator configures the external encryption keys.
security.name: Complainant name
security.identitySaved: Identity encrypted and saved. General case responses do not include these values.
security.onePerLine: Enter one value per line. Empty lists are allowed. These review signals do not create statutory rules.

text.title: Complaint language and translation
text.originalNotice: Original case text is preserved. Complaint-language processing is separate from the interface language.
text.heuristicNotice: Script hints are not calibrated language identification. Shared scripts and Latin text may remain undetermined. No confidence percentage is inferred.
text.translationNotice: No external translation service is connected for case text. Save a separate translation draft, then obtain an independent authorized review. This does not approve interface translations or official terminology.
text.saved: Language annotation recorded; original text preserved.
text.failed: The annotation could not be completed. Check scope, the current source version and independent review requirements.

mode.lexical_fallback: Unicode lexical fallback — no semantic cross-language understanding

overlapSettings.title: Overlap review configuration
overlapSettings.configurationNotice: Versioned engineering settings for review assistance. These values are not calibrated probabilities or verified legal rules. Existing reviewer decisions are retained.
overlapSettings.missingNotice: Only available signals enter weight normalization. Missing values are neutral.
overlapSettings.mandatoryNotice: Mandatory review: same institution, same category, both cases open and different handling Bureaus. This rule always requests human review; it does not declare duplication.
overlapSettings.optionalNotice: Review is based on available relationship signals.
overlapSettings.dateNotice: Use source received date, then received date. Compare the two calendar dates. Missing dates are neutral. Distant dates suppress ordinary candidates except an exact same-source reference; mandatory review remains active.
overlapSettings.rollbackNotice: Restoring an earlier version creates a new version. It does not rewrite history or rescore earlier decisions.
overlapSettings.failed: Action failed. Check access, current version, required reason and field values; refresh if another official changed the record.
overlapSettings.signalTable: Available signals and weighted contributions out of 100
overlapSettings.possible_related: Possible related case — human review required
overlapSettings.caveat: These signals are not a duplication decision, a merge, a finding of wrongdoing, a calibrated probability or a statutory conclusion.
overlapSettings.entityNotice: Record only verified institutional department, programme or document codes used in this case. Do not enter person identifiers. Codes supplement the original record; they do not change its narrative.
overlapSettings.entityCodes: Institutional entity codes and review rescan
overlapSettings.rescanned: Review run recorded. Existing alerts and reviewer decisions were retained. New authorized review items, if any, are available in Overlap Detection.

family.title: Case family
family.visibilityNotice: This graph and its tables show only cases and relationships readable under your current role, assignment, Bureau, region and confidentiality grants. Hidden records and counts are excluded.
family.graphDescription: Cases link to duplicate, related and canonical merged cases. Coordination sessions connect a case to participating Bureaus. Use the tables below for complete labels and dates.
family.largeGraph: Use the complete tables below for this large authorized family. The diagram is limited to 40 nodes for readability.
family.empty: No readable case records in this view.
family.graphLegend: Solid arrows identify canonical merges. Dashed lines identify reviewed duplicate/related links or Bureau coordination; see the relationship table for exact types.
family.preservationNotice: Every original ID, case status, source obligation, deadline, evidence item, assignment, transfer and unresolved task remains on its original case. A canonical merge does not close a case, stop its clock, remove evidence or grant access.
family.relationshipNotice: Related and duplicate links record reviewer decisions. A canonical merge is a separate controlled action. Coordination connects a case to its authorized Bureau session; no case-to-case relationship is invented.
family.mergeNotice: Only a Competent Authority with current access to all affected family cases may prepare and confirm a merge. Select an explicit canonical case, review the independent obligations and record a reason. No record is physically deleted or consolidated into broader access.
family.reviewConfirmation: I reviewed the original records, selected canonical case and independent source obligations. I understand that all evidence, deadlines and unresolved work remain intact.
family.mergedNotice: Canonical merge recorded. Original case records and independent obligations remain intact.
family.reverseConfirmation: I reviewed this relationship and confirm its reversal. Original case work remains intact.
family.reversedNotice: Reversal recorded; both the original merge and its correction remain in history.
family.failed: Family action could not be completed. Check current case access, selected root cases, preparation expiry/version, reason and explicit review confirmation; refresh and prepare again if records changed.

imports.title: Import intake records
imports.notice: Preview CSV or Excel files, or simulate email intake. Valid rows become unresolved intake drafts; human institution selection and supervisory registration remain required.
imports.limits: UTF-8 CSV or one visible XLSX sheet; 2 MiB file, 200 data rows, 32 columns, 20,000 characters per cell. Formulas, complex cells, external workbook links, embedded files and macro-enabled formats are rejected. Dates must be YYYY-MM-DD text.
imports.adapters: Email is an internal simulation only. CSS and CPGRAMS are not connected. No official government API contract or live connection is implied.
imports.mappingNotice: Map each intake field to one source column. External references are required for imports. Preview validates classification, dates, handling scope and institution candidates without registering complaints.
imports.subject: Subject
imports.emailNotice: This form uses an internal fixture, not a connected mailbox or official contract. Attachments are unsupported. The shared batch key above also applies here.
imports.partialNotice: Partial success: only valid, new source references create intake drafts. Invalid rows remain in this run with errors. Submit corrected rows under a new batch key; successful source references are deduplicated. A replay key cannot be reused for different content.
imports.humanSelection: Human selection is required before registration
imports.originals: Source wording is preserved. CSV formula-like text is stored as literal text; spreadsheet formulas are not evaluated. No complaint registration or institution selection occurs automatically.
imports.confirm: I reviewed the preview and authorize importing valid rows as intake drafts, retaining failed-row errors for correction.
imports.committed: Import run recorded. Review row results and resolve new drafts in the intake queue.
imports.failed: Import failed. Check file format, limits, mapping, replay key, source reference, permissions and current preview version.

auditIntegrity.title: Audit integrity verification
auditIntegrity.notice: Verify the global SHA-256 event chain without exposing case details. Existing historical events form an explicitly unverified legacy baseline.
auditIntegrity.head: Current chain head
auditIntegrity.checkpointNotice: Export a checkpoint and retain it in independently protected storage. Configure AUDIT_CHECKPOINT_FILE on the server to verify future state against that copy. Downloading alone does not provide independent protection.
auditIntegrity.exported: Checkpoint created and downloaded. Protect the copy independently before relying on it to detect a complete rewrite.
auditIntegrity.threatModel: This history is tamper-evident, not absolutely immutable. Deterministic serialization, sequence numbers, hashes and append-only database projections detect supported alterations, deletions and reordering. An attacker who can rewrite the whole database and internal checkpoints requires detection by an independently protected checkpoint.
auditIntegrity.onFailure: If verification fails, preserve the affected state and compare backups and independent anchors. Writes fail closed; the application does not silently repair, re-seed or rewrite a broken chain.
auditIntegrity.failed: Audit verification or checkpoint export failed. Preserve data and check current access, chain state and independent checkpoint configuration.

slaPolicy.title: Operational SLA policies
slaPolicy.operationalNotice: Configurable operational deadlines. These defaults and administrator references do not establish statutory or legal requirements. Existing cases retain their applied policy until explicit authorized recalculation.
slaPolicy.failed: Unable to complete the SLA action. Refresh and check your access, current version, policy and review reason.
slaPolicy.referenceNotice: Unverified reference supplied by an administrator
slaPolicy.legacyNotice: Existing deadline retained. No versioned policy has been adopted for this case.
slaPolicy.recalculateReview: I reviewed the policy and the effect of recalculating this deadline.
slaPolicy.pauseNotice: Only reasons explicitly permitted by the applied policy allow a pause. Resume before recalculating. Recalculation reapplies retained pause intervals to the selected policy.
slaPolicy.matchingNotice: All non-empty selectors must match. Highest precedence wins; equal precedence uses policy ID order. Empty selectors match all values. Effective dates are inclusive in the policy timezone. Separate non-grievance lifecycles still require review. Enter lists as comma-separated codes; holidays as YYYY-MM-DD. Disable obsolete policies; retain historical IDs.
slaPolicy.name: Policy name
slaPolicy.deliveryNotice: Internal alerts are permission checked. Email and SMS delivery is disabled or simulated in development only; no real messages are sent. Duplicate storms count human-confirmed duplicate submissions and require review, without implying misconduct.
slaPolicy.saved: New policy version saved. Existing case clocks remain pinned to their applied policy.
slaPolicy.acknowledgementNotice: Acknowledgement suppresses this alert only. It does not pause a clock, dispose a case or remove any obligation.
slaPolicy.noAlerts: No SLA alerts in your current authorized scope.

reporting.title: Filtered reports and schedules
reporting.notice: Reports contain only cases readable under your current role, Bureau, region, assignment and confidentiality grants. No geographic boundaries or coordinates are inferred.
reporting.failed: Report action failed. Check your permissions, filter values, date range, current schedule version and the 5,000-case export limit.
reporting.filterNotice: Blank fields include all authorized values. Bureau means current handling Bureau. Use exact institution IDs, region labels, status values and configured case type/source codes. Periods use UTC received dates; financial reporting uses April–March. Financial month 1 means April.
reporting.scopeNotice: Exports use the displayed applied filters. Draft filter edits take effect after Apply. All figures describe current authorized records, without inferring misconduct or legal compliance.
reporting.pdfNotice: PDF includes counts and internal case IDs, with full original Unicode ledger fields embedded as report.csv and scope.json. CSV and Excel preserve original text; no narrative or identity details are exported. Narrow filters if more than 5,000 cases match.
reporting.regionNotice: Labels come from authorized institution master records. Zero means no matching cases in that region; unknown/unassigned means the region is missing. Click a region to apply its filter. Colors do not carry the meaning alone.
reporting.ledgerNotice: The first 100 matching cases are displayed. Exports include every matching case up to the stated limit. Type/source missing values are not guessed for historical cases.
reporting.scheduleNotice: Save the current filter form without fixed dates. Monthly and quarterly jobs generate the previous complete UTC period using current access permissions. The selected calendar/financial basis is recorded. No external delivery occurs. Editing or disabling a schedule retains prior packs.
reporting.name: Schedule name
reporting.packNotice: Packs and download history are private. Generation and every download recheck current permissions; packs with any case no longer readable are unavailable. Repeated generation of the same scheduled period returns its existing pack.
